title: Layers: Show Widgets on the Right Pages | Orchard Core
description:
A widget is a block of content that a theme can show in a named zone of a page. Showing every widget on every page does not suit a site with different kinds of pages.

Layers solve this. A layer holds a rule made of conditions, and its widgets appear only on the pages where the rule is true. This video creates a layer for the blog posts of a site, places a widget in a zone, and checks the result on the site.

In this video:
• How zones, widgets and layers fit together
• The Widgets and Layers page
• Listing the zones that widgets can use
• Creating a layer with a Url condition
• Adding a Paragraph widget to a zone
• Checking the widget on the site
• Moving a widget to another position or zone
• Editing and deleting a layer
